source_title: 3-time para-Asian Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav dies by suicide - India Today
source_excerpt:
Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav has died by suicide after allegedly consuming poison at his residence. The postmortem examination is underway in Delhi.
Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav has died by suicide after allegedly consuming poison at his residence, with a postmortem examination underway at a Delhi hospital on Wednesday.
S Satyanarayana, head coach of the Indian para-athletics team, confirmed the incident, saying he had learnt of the tragedy but that Yadav's body was still at the hospital.
"Neeraj has died by suicide. It is very unfortunate that such a thing has happened," Satyanarayana said.
The 42-year-old Yadav, who competed in the F55 category, was reportedly under emotional stress after missing the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya earlier this month due to a doping suspension. The circumstances surrounding his death are yet to be established.
Satyanarayana added, "I can't speculate the exact reason but if you ask me, I would say a sportsperson should face the highs and lows with equanimity. It's unfortunate that he chose this far and take the extreme step."
One of India's accomplished para-athletes, Yadav won three gold medals at the Asian Para Games - a javelin title at the 2018 edition in Jakarta, followed by gold medals in the javelin and discus at Hangzhou in 2023.
Diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis at the age of seven, Yadav initially took up wheelchair tennis before switching to para-athletics, where he went on to make his mark on the international stage.
Yadav competed in the F55 category, which covers seated field events, including the shot put, discus and javelin. - Ends
hi_body:
तीन बार के एशियाई पैरा खेलों के स्वर्ण पदक विजेता नीरज यादव का उनके आवास पर कथित तौर पर जहर खाने के बाद आत्महत्या से निधन हो गया है। रिपोर्टों और खेल अधिकारियों के बयानों के अनुसार, बुधवार को दिल्ली के एक अस्पताल में उनका पोस्टमॉर्टम किया जा रहा था।

भारतीय पैरा-एथलेटिक्स टीम के मुख्य कोच एस. सत्यनारायण ने इस घटना की पुष्टि की। सत्यनारायण ने कहा, "नीरज ने आत्महत्या कर ली है। यह बहुत दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है कि ऐसा हुआ है," और उन्होंने यह भी बताया कि आधिकारिक प्रक्रियाओं के दौरान एथलीट का शव अस्पताल में ही था।

## खेल करियर और उपलब्धियां

* **F55 वर्ग के प्रतियोगी:** यादव ने शॉट पुट, डिस्कस थ्रो और जैवलिन थ्रो सहित बैठे हुए फील्ड इवेंट्स में भाग लिया।
* **प्रमुख पदक:** जकार्ता में 2018 के एशियाई पैरा खेलों में भाला फेंक (जैवलिन) में स्वर्ण, और हांगकांग में 2023 के खेलों में भाला फेंक तथा चक्का फेंक (डिस्कस) में दो स्वर्ण पदक जीते।
* **पृष्ठभूमि:** सात वर्ष की आयु में पोलियो के बाद के पक्षाघात से पीड़ित होने के बाद, उन्होंने पैरा-एथलेटिक्स में आने से पहले व्हीलचेयर टेनिस खेलना शुरू किया था।

## रिपोर्ट की गई परिस्थितियां और आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया

रिपोर्टों में बताया गया कि 42 वर्षीय एथलीट डोपिंग निलंबन के कारण ऐची-नागोया में हालिया एशियाई पैरा खेलों में भाग न ले पाने के कारण कथित तौर पर भावनात्मक तनाव में थे। हालांकि, उनकी मृत्यु के आसपास की परिस्थितियों को अधिकारियों द्वारा आधिकारिक तौर पर स्थापित किया जाना अभी बाकी है।

कोच सत्यनारायण ने खेलों में मानसिक लचीलेपन पर टिप्पणी करते हुए कहा कि वह सटीक कारण के बारे में अनुमान नहीं लगा सकते, लेकिन एथليट्स को करियर के उतार-चढ़ाव का सामना करना चाहिए।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन

* **जानकारी का सत्यापन:** सत्यापित अपडेट चाहने वाले पाठकों को आधिकारिक खेल प्राधिकरणों, कानून प्रवर्तन और मान्यता प्राप्त खेल समाचार प्रकाशनों के बयानों पर नजर रखनी चाहिए।
* **सहायता संसाधन:** भावनात्मक संकट या मानसिक स्वास्थ्य चुनौतियों का सामना करने वाले व्यक्ति गोपनीय सहायता के लिए समर्पित हेल्पलाइन सेवाओं से संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
Neeraj Yadav, a three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist, died by suicide at his residence after allegedly consuming poison, according to reports and statements from athletic officials. A postmortem examination was underway at a Delhi hospital on Wednesday following the incident.

S Satyanarayana, head coach of the Indian para-athletics team, confirmed the tragedy to the media. "Neeraj has died by suicide. It is very unfortunate that such a thing has happened," Satyanarayana stated, noting that the athlete's body remained at the hospital while official procedures were conducted.

## Athletic Career and Achievements

* **F55 Category Competitor:** Yadav competed in seated field events, including the javelin, discus, and shot put.
* **Major Medals:** Secured a javelin gold at the 2018 Asian Para Games in Jakarta, followed by two gold medals in javelin and discus at the 2023 Games in Hangzhou.
* **Background:** Diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis at age seven, he initially played wheelchair tennis before transitioning to para-athletics.

## Reported Circumstances and Official Response

Reports indicated that the 42-year-old athlete was facing emotional stress after missing the recent Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya due to a doping suspension. However, the complete circumstances surrounding his death are yet to be officially established by authorities.

Satyanarayana commented on the mental resilience required in sports, stating he could not speculate on the exact reason but emphasized that athletes must navigate career highs and lows.

## Practical Implications and Verification

* **Information Verification:** Readers seeking verified updates should monitor statements from official sports authorities, law enforcement, and recognized sports news publications.
* **Support Resources:** Individuals facing emotional distress or mental health challenges can reach out to dedicated helpline services for confidential support.
